whoami.roleDescription: building clean APIs, robust tests, and solid CI/CD pipelines
whoami.intro:
TypeScript-first. React/Next.js on the frontend. Node.js with NestJS or Express/Fastify on the backend. PostgreSQL + Prisma/Drizzle for data.

focus on saubere APIs, Tests und CI/CD - nicht auf buzzwords.
whoami.whatIdo:
i build full-stack TypeScript applications with clean architecture.

frontend with React/Next.js, backend with Node.js (NestJS or Express/Fastify), PostgreSQL with Prisma or Drizzle for the database.

only add Redis when it actually makes sense. Docker for containerization. GitHub Actions for CI/CD. One hosting provider, not all of them.

sentry for monitoring. vitest/jest + playwright for testing.
whoami.experience: years of building and breaking things - from Discord bots to full-stack web applications to security research tools.
whoami.alsoGoodAt: nebenbei gut in Rust, Go und Python. AI stack - backend Kenntnisse, nicht Frontend-AI-Dings.
